text:
alex (support): Hey team, customer AcmeMaps says their daily usage CSV for 2026-03-16 shows a big drop — looks like events between 00:00-00:10 local time went into the previous day. They bill in Australia/Sydney (AEDT). Can someone triage? @maya (cc @tj)

maya (sre): Got it. Org id and a sample row from the CSV?

alex (support): Org: org_87XJ. Sample from CSV (date column + event_count):
```
2026-03-15,42
```
But their event log shows requests at 2026-03-16T00:04:12+11:00 that should be counted on 2026-03-16. Exported CSV date shows 2026-03-15.

tj (analytics): Hmm. Export pipeline usually normalizes to UTC then buckets by day in org tz. Can you paste the export request payload or job id?

alex (support): Job id: export_98765. Payload snippet from support UI shows no tz param:
```json
{"org_id":"org_87XJ","range":"2026-03-16","format":"csv"}
```

export-bot: Export job export_98765 started at 1862345679

maya (sre): Repro steps I tried locally: create event at 2026-03-16T00:03:00+11, run /v1/exports/daily?date=2026-03-16 (no tz) -> CSV contains row for 2026-03-15. Looks like fallback to UTC day-boundary when tz param is omitted.

alex (support): Customer says this started after the analytics rewrite last month. They didn't change org tz.

data-ops-bot: Quick find: export-service line 214 casts event_time::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' then date_trunc('day', ...) before applying org timezone. Suspect order-of-ops bug.

tj (analytics): Confirmed. Fix: apply org timezone offset first, then truncate to date. Suggested SQL patch:
```sql
date_trunc('day', (event_time AT TIME ZONE org_timezone))::date as day
```
Try hotfix in staging and run the export_98765 repro.

maya (sre): Workaround for customer: schedule CSV export for 1 hour later or set explicit tz param in export API (we can call /v1/exports/daily?date=2026-03-16&tz=Australia/Sydney). I'm pushing a short-term advisory to their AE.

alex (support): Thx — I'll notify the customer and open INC-2026-334 to track. @tj can you PR the SQL change and include a unit test for DST edgecases? :eyes:

tj (analytics): On it. Will include tests for Australia/Sydney and America/Los_Angeles boundaries.

alex (support): Closing loop here: notifying AcmeMaps and adding note to the incident. Will update once patch is deployed. :thumbsup:
